---
title: Interactive Rmd
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---
  
```{r, echo = FALSE}
numericInput("n",
"How many cars?", 5)
#input widgets allow users to interact with the code
#google shiny widgets to see all widgets we can play with
renderTable({
head(cars, input$n)
})
#render table reacts to changes
```
